title: LD Expert with Jill Stowell - Videos
description:
The LD Expert Podcast explains why bright children and adults struggle with learning, and what actually helps.

This podcast focuses on dyslexia, learning disabilities, auditory processing disorder (APD), and attention challenges.

Hosted by Jill Stowell, founder of Stowell Learning Centers and four-time #1 best-selling author, the LD Expert Podcast helps parents, educators, and professionals understand the root causes of learning struggles and why accommodations and tutoring alone often fall short.

Learn more or speak with a learning specialist:
https://stowellcenter.com/call

Free resources, research, events, and more:
https://linktr.ee/stowellcenter
